# Reporting a security vulnerability

Do not publish secrets, private publisher agreements, personal study notes, or unpatched vulnerability details in a public issue or pull request.

Report privately using [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/andrewzaia/Scripture-Trails/security/advisories/new) **if enabled**. Otherwise use an existing private channel with the repository maintainer. Never disclose a secret publicly to request remediation.

Include the affected component, reproduction steps, impact and a safely redacted proof of concept. Do not include actual credentials or personal data. We do not promise a particular response deadline.

Fixes to published code and release infrastructure require the existing protected PR, Semantic Versioning release, paired changelogs, CI and exact-commit production verification.
